items.disposition: Five-above/twenty-five-following and named aspect-derived regions do not by themselves settle every modern house/coordinate convention.
Three modes to one or more places, comparison across sects and equal authorities need an explicit interpretation.
Keep adopted formula and editor-reported alternatives separate; do not treat a variant as an independent confirmatory author.
Following rays versus leading horimaea require explicit region and boundary policy before engine compilation.
Horary amounts and fading toward setting are specified qualitatively; full mixed Mercury and positional scaling remain to implement.
Some sextiles/trines have special conditions; term-table choice, witnessing, numbers/power and under-beams exclusions all remain prerequisites.
Bodily latitude condition is not the same as an aspect condition; no generic declination substitute.
Similar temporal position and semicircle language not independently resolved from Greek. Bounded arithmetic is not a complete primary-direction engine.
Main text uses rounded integers. Note gives finer table values; visually checked 147;44 is misread in OCR as 147;14.
Explicit approximate six-hour interpolation should not be claimed universally exact.
Later IV.10 not yet read; no person mortality/crisis classifier is compiled.
Past-event candidate preference is explicitly allowed by source but is development evidence; future untouched tests remain separate.
